faqs.question: Which cloud platforms does TechBeeps support?
faqs.answer: We provide full lifecycle services for all major cloud providers including Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and hybrid on-premise cloud configurations.

faqs.question: How do you ensure zero downtime during cloud migration?
faqs.answer: We utilize phased migration strategies, automated database replication, and rigorous staging validation to ensure seamless cutover without interrupting live operations.

faqs.question: How can cloud migration reduce our operational costs?
faqs.answer: Cloud migration eliminates expensive on-premise hardware maintenance, enables pay-as-you-go pricing, and uses auto-scaling so you only pay for compute resources you actively use.

faqs.question: How do you handle cloud security and data compliance?
faqs.answer: We enforce least-privilege IAM policies, TLS 1.3 encryption at rest and in transit, automated vulnerability patching, and compliance adherence for ISO 27001, GDPR, and SOC 2.

faqs.question: Do you offer ongoing cloud maintenance and monitoring after migration?
faqs.answer: Yes! We provide 24/7 proactive cloud infrastructure management, automated backup routines, security monitoring, and regular performance tuning.
